FN-96DLMMP-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 121
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/11/2025
Senate Bill 121 as introduced could decrease the financial obligations of the state and local
governments engaging in certain public work contracts by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the method of public notice chosen, pursuant to the provisions of this bill, for competitive
sealed bid contracts.
Page 1
